name: list_items
description: List all available items in the inventory. Use this when the customer asks what items are available, wants to browse products, or asks about the menu/catalog.

name: get_item
description: Get details of a specific item by its ID. Use this when the customer asks about a particular item or wants more information about a product.

item_id.description: The unique ID of the item to retrieve

name: create_item
description: Create a new item in the inventory. Use this when the customer wants to place an order or add a new product.

name: update_item
description: Update an existing item's details. Use this when the customer wants to change an order or modify product information.

item_id.description: The unique ID of the item to update

name: delete_item
description: Delete an item from the inventory. Use this when the customer wants to cancel an order or remove a product.

item_id.description: The unique ID of the item to delete
